message: EXEC SQL INCLUDE SQLCA (line 26) under 01 WS-DB2-AREA and COPY RTNCODE (line 30) under 01 RC-REQUEST-AREA bring in level-01 records (SQL-STATUS-CODES, RETURN-CODE-AREA). A level-01 inside a copybook starts a new record, so WS-DB2-AREA and RC-REQUEST-AREA have no subordinate items of their own (inline_bytes 0). The expansions are registered as EXPANDS_COPY from the holding 01 records, whose total_bytes therefore include the copybook record sizes (35 and 165).
